_about: The objectives reread (S649; Sam, 2026-11-13: "add objectives to the collection list of data from cors. they should be collected when slos are collected"). Every loaded college whose course SLOs are in course_outcomes and whose objectives are not, with what to do. kb/_course_outcomes_read.py files both kinds in the one pass on every read path; the reads below were filed before it took objectives (S584, 2026-11-05) and carry no objectives key. A full read files no page text, so none of them can be a reparse: each is read again. Runner minutes only, no model call, so the $40 extraction go never applies. One host at a time, most exhibit articulations first (the sum over the host's colleges, scripts/next_slo_colleges.py's count). Guarded by tests/course_outcomes_objectives_standing_test.py. Short form: objectives_reread_plan.md.

how.trigger: course-outcomes-read.yml and course-outcomes-load.yml start on a push to a claude/** branch that changes kb/course_outcomes/.run or kb/course_outcomes/.load from main's copy; neither has workflow_dispatch. The dispatch is a new branch off main carrying the trigger file's lines.
how.read: On a new branch claude/slo-objectives-<host> off main, write kb/course_outcomes/.run with the read lines (run= takes the date), commit with a message that does not start with Merge, push, open a draft PR. The slices run one at a time and commit back to the branch.
how.load: When the new run's slices are all filed complete, confirm with `python3 kb/_course_outcomes_load.py --host <host> --slugs <slugs> --kind objective --dry`: it prints each chosen slice's run, and must name only the new run, all N parts (a kind= load refuses a read whose newest run is not filed whole). scripts/next_slo_colleges.py says done for these colleges (a load receipt names them), never load, so it cannot signal a reread. Then write kb/course_outcomes/.load with the step's load lines on the same branch and push. kind=objective posts the objective rows only (the reread's SLO rows are held back and counted); slugs= keeps the other colleges a host files out of the load. A .load without kind=objective would post any SLO block that changed since the first read beside the loaded one: never on a reread.
how.one_host: Start a host's read only when the previous host is loaded or stopped. Never two readers on one host: Coastline and Golden West share catalog.cccd.edu and run in turn.
how.merge: In the same PR as the receipt: move the step from order to done ({slug, read: <run>, objectives: "n of m pages"} per college), renumber the steps left, and return kb/course_outcomes/.load to main's text if the next ordinary load should not inherit kind= (the loader refuses a kind= load that finds no rows of that kind, so a stale line fails loudly). Merge on a passing test (step 11 of docs/reference/scheduled_sessions.md).
how.downstream: The reread files a second set of slice files beside the first. The loader and kb/_build_commons_status.py count each slice from its newest run, so the Commons outcomes card does not double; the first read's files stay as filed.

undo.receipt: kb/receipts/course_outcomes_<host>_<load run>.json: {host, load_run, kind: "objective", held_back, posted (rows in batches sent), inserted, kept, inserted_keys: [{id, college, course_code, kind}], rollback: "delete ... where id in (...);", rollback_by_key_if_error (only when error is set): "delete ... where kind in ('objective') and (college, read_run) in (...);"}
undo.how: Run the receipt's rollback: it deletes exactly the ids the load's responses named, every one kind objective (Rule 10 a2). Only if the receipt carries an error (a batch whose response was lost may still have committed) does it file rollback_by_key_if_error: read_run is a column of course_outcomes and each reread's run is fresh, so it takes exactly the objective rows that read's loads inserted.
undo.never_replaces: course_outcomes_load() is insert-only (on conflict (college, course_code, source_url, kind, fingerprint) do nothing), and kind is part of the key, so an objective row never updates or replaces an SLO row; with kind=objective no SLO row is posted at all.
